listing.description_html:
Track every lead and proposal from first contact to won or lost: weighted pipeline value, win rate, follow-ups due, and which lead sources actually bring paying clients.

This tracker keeps every lead on one row with its value and stage. It calculates a weighted pipeline value from the probability you give each stage, flags open deals that have not been contacted for longer than your follow-up limit, and reports your win rate, average deal size and results by lead source.

What's included

  • One row per lead from first contact to won or lost, with value and stage
  • Weighted pipeline value from stage probabilities you set
  • FOLLOW UP flag for open deals that have gone quiet past your limit
  • Win rate, average won deal and days to close
  • Results by lead source: leads, wins, won value and win rate
  • PDF guide with a worked ten-lead example

Who it's for

  • Freelancers sending proposals
  • Small agencies and studios
  • Consultants and coaches
  • Trades and contractors quoting jobs

You get: client_pipeline_proposal_tracker.xlsx (Settings, Pipeline, Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is an organising aid. Weighted values are estimates based on the stage probabilities you set, not forecasts of what will close.
